pairs.why: The two are almost the same render, with the same smooth, saturated cartoon finish and the same closed-eye man and bonnet pig, so neither reads as clearly closer to the real cards.
B's pig has a rounder, rosier head that sits slightly closer to the real pig card, but otherwise the two have the same finish.
B's man has open, smiling eyes behind his glasses, and B's pig wears a straw hat with a blue ribbon like the real cards, so B's characters look more like the cast.
A's man looks out with open eyes, and A's pig wears a straw hat with a blue ribbon like the real cards, so A's characters look more like the cast.
B is slightly cleaner and less busy, with simple shapes like the real cards, but the rendering and color are almost the same.
A is slightly simpler and its figure shapes are cleaner, but the rendering and finish are basically the same.
B's man has open, smiling eyes and a friendly face like the real dad card, while A repeats the closed-eye pose.
A's man has open, smiling eyes like the real dad card, and his build and smooth shading match the cast more closely than B's closed-eye pose.
